title: Page 8
content_zh:
「……很快的，很快……」
「那我就不打扰二哥赶回布庄了，我回房继续照顾无雍。」
话刚说完，燕晓苗就毫不留情的转身准备关门，戚无烟急忙又再开口：「四弟妹，等等。」
「二哥，还有什么事吗？」
「你……」戚无烟挣扎着，最后还是没有将劝她看开的话给说出口，或许对她来说，沉醉在自己所制造出的美梦当中比较……幸福。
他很担心四弟，但他也同样担心四弟妹，如果四弟永远醒不过来，她是不是也会沉醉在自己的美梦里，永远醒不过来？
或许醒不过来……对她不一定是件坏事，也说不定……
「咳咳……四弟妹，很久没在四弟房间以外的地方见到你了，大哥可以乘机和你随便聊聊吗？」
燕晓苗走在穿廊上，看到戚无双站在一旁的小花园中间，似乎是特别等她的，她非常听话的转个弯走过去，笑容满面地说：「大哥，有事请长话短说，因为我还得回去陪无雍呢。」
「这大哥知道，大哥会尽量长话短说的。」从两位弟弟那听到对四弟妹的担心，戚无双只好亲自出马，虽然他知道，或许是一点用也没有。「四弟妹，你看起来似乎憔悴了不少。」
「有吗？」她可一点都不觉得。
果真是当局者迷，旁观者清呀，她原本红润的脸颊都瘦下来了，又怎么可能不憔悴？
「对了，大哥最近接到燕云山的来信，你大伯父很想念你，燕茗也是，他们都在抱怨你一出了燕云山就忘了该回去看看他们，他们可寂寞了。」
燕晓苗突然一愣，有种恍然醒悟的感觉，频频点头。「这样说来……我似乎是真的很久没想到他们了……」
「是呀，所以你……是不是该回去燕云山瞧瞧，顺便乘机放松一下自己的心情，嗯？」
「大哥说的有道理，我是该回去瞧瞧了……」
没错，就是这样！难得燕晓苗听得进戚无双的话，他于是再接再厉。「你可以放心，一路上——」
「不急不急。」燕晓苗笑着打断他的话，狠浇他一桶冷水。「等无雍醒来后，我再和他一同回去，这样会比较好。」
「……」
「大哥还有事吗？如果没事的话，那我就要回去陪无雍了。」

戚无双说不出话来，燕晓苗也不浪费时间，转身马上要走，瞧着她那轻快离去的背影，戚无双终于忍不住沈下脸，狠下心要她面对事实。
「燕晓苗，你何必再继续这样装疯卖傻、自欺欺人下去呢？」
燕晓苗瞬间顿下脚步，却依然没回头。「大哥，我不懂你的意思。」
「你怎么可能会不懂？」戚无双轻叹口气。「四弟已经昏迷了将近一个月，会醒过来的机会是越来越渺茫了，这是大家都知道的事，我就不相信你不知道。」
他们虽然也感到很心痛、很无奈，但也只能慢慢接受这样的事情，他们的四弟很有可能不会再醒来，他们得要有这样的心理准备。
但她不是，她一直在逃避、拒绝接受事实，这对她来说不是一件好事，她迟早都要面对事实的。
「无雍他只是很累……很累，所以才会睡了那么久，再给他一点时间，我相信他一定会醒……」
「你相信他一定会醒来？你只是在逼迫、说服自己，因为你无法接受他有可能永远不会醒来的事实，你这是在逃避！」
「我没……」
「你有，而且是从一开始就这么做了，你要是再这样下去，总有一天会真的把自己给逼疯的，懂不懂呀？」
「我不懂！」燕晓苗终于生气地回过头，再也笑不出来。「为什么，为什么你们每个人都想逼我承认他不会醒，你们真的很残忍、残酷，简直是冷血至极！」
为什么不能让她保有那最后一丝希望，一定要逼她彻底绝望才行？她才不要这么做，就算所有人都放弃他了，她也绝不！
没想到燕晓苗是如此的执迷不悟，这让戚无双感到非常头痛。「四弟妹，你还有大好的青春可过，我们不忍心瞧你就这么……」
「我的人生要怎么过，只有我自己可以决定，你们无权干涉！」她咆哮出声，已经不想再听戚无双说些什么了。「就算无雍他真的永远醒不过来，我也不会离开他，你们谁都别想将我和他给拆散！」
话一说完，燕晓苗马上决绝离去，态度异常顽强，这让戚无双不由得大皱起眉头，完全拿她没任何办法。
「四弟呀四弟，你要是再不醒来，就真的要造孽了……」
第9章(1)
燕晓苗怒气冲冲地跑回房，余怒未消，拚命喘气，紧咬住的下唇都快被咬出血来，但她却不觉得痛，只感到非常的……不甘心。
为什么大家都要逼她面对现实？她知道自己在做什么，不必他们多事干预！
好不容易咽下喉中那一股气，在心情稍微平复之后，燕晓苗才来到床边，一如以往般坐着，无言地凝望着戚无雍。

他依旧沉睡，睡得好深好沈，就像一尊早已失去灵魂的人偶，这一个月来，他不曾开口说一句话，也不睁开眼看她，只让她孤独的一个人唱独角戏，一出接着一出……
从怀中掏出那一对贝壳耳环，五彩斑斓的小贝壳镶在银线中，上下错落的摆动着，有种轻灵可爱的感觉，轻抚着贝壳的纹路，她瞧得有些出神，慢慢地，又漾起了一抹淡淡的笑容。
「我说过，会让你瞧瞧的，而且绝不会忘……」
想起戚无雍那一天为了要出其不意送她耳环，而使出的小小诡计，燕晓苗不由得轻笑出声，当时的感动依然存在，可是这样珍贵的回忆……却只剩下她一个人记得了。
「无雍，我终于知道，原来贝壳是长这个样子，与其说像耳朵，我倒觉得像是扇子，你该不会是故意在耍着我玩的吧？」
戚无雍不肯定，却也不否定，任由她继续猜测。「算了，就算你真的是耍着我好玩，我也认了，贝壳很漂亮，这是我目前最珍惜的宝贝，啊……对了，第一珍惜的宝贝，当然还是非你莫属喽！」
摊开他的掌心，她将耳环放在他手上。「你还记得吗，我曾说过，我要你亲手帮我戴上它，所以直到现在我都不肯戴，因为少了你，这耳环……就失去它之所以珍贵的意义了。」
它的珍贵不在值多少钱，而是戚无雍所投注在耳环上的心意，她珍惜的不是耳环本身，而是他，是他那一颗真挚的心呀！
拿起他的手，连着他掌心的贝壳耳环，燕晓苗将手移往自己的耳垂，一脸的期待。
「帮我戴上耳环吧，我不准你说话不算话，快点……这动作不会很难，只要用手指轻勾一下……」
他的手都还没碰到她的耳垂，掌心内的贝壳耳环就掉落在床上，让她顿时僵住所有动作。
愣了好一会儿，一滴滴心酸的泪水终于沾上锦被、沾上被她牢牢握住的那一只手，开始一发不可收拾。
「为什么……为什么你就是不肯醒来……」
燕晓苗彻底崩溃，痛哭出声，难以忍受的心痛正强力的折磨她，逼得她快抓狂了。
「戚无雍，你回答我、快点回答我呀……」她的忍耐已经到达极限了，这一个月的日子就像是酷刑一样，深深打击她、让她备受挫折，原本的希望也一点一滴慢慢流逝，开始心灰意冷，让她感到惶恐不已。
content_en:
"...Soon, soon..."
"Then I won't bother my second brother and rush back to Buzhuang. I will go back to my room and continue to take care of Wuyong."
As soon as she finished speaking, Yan Xiaomiao turned around without mercy and was about to close the door. Qi Wuyan hurriedly spoke again: "Fourth brother and sister, wait."
"Second brother, is there anything else?"
"You..." Qi Wuyan struggled, but in the end he didn't say the words to persuade her to look away. Maybe for her, it would be more...happy to indulge in the beautiful dream she created.
He was worried about his fourth brother, but he was also worried about his fourth younger sister. If his fourth brother could never wake up, would she also be intoxicated in her sweet dream and never wake up?
Maybe she can't wake up... It's not necessarily a bad thing for her, maybe...
"Ahem...Fourth brother and sister, I haven't seen you outside the fourth brother's room for a long time. Can eldest brother take the opportunity to have a casual chat with you?"
Yan Xiaomiao was walking in the corridor and saw Qi Wushuang standing in the middle of the small garden. He seemed to be waiting for her. She turned around and walked over very obediently. She said with a smile: "Brother, if you have anything to do, please keep it short, because I have to go back to accompany Wuyong."
"This eldest brother knows that he will try to keep his story short." After hearing the concerns about the fourth younger brother and sister from his two younger brothers, Qi Wushuang had no choice but to take action personally, although he knew that it might be of no use at all. "Fourth younger brother and sister, you seem to be quite haggard."
"Really?" She didn't think so at all.
If she is really obsessed with the authorities, it is clear to onlookers that her originally rosy cheeks have lost weight, so how can she not look haggard?
"By the way, eldest brother recently received a letter from Yanyun Mountain. Your eldest uncle misses you very much, and so does Yan Ming. They are all complaining that you forgot to go back to see them as soon as you left Yanyun Mountain. They are lonely."
Yan Xiaomiao was suddenly stunned, feeling as if she had suddenly awakened, and nodded frequently. "In this way...it seems like I haven't thought about them for a long time..."
"Yes, so you...should you go back to Yanyun Mountain to take a look and take the opportunity to relax yourself, eh?"
"Brother is right, I should go back and take a look..."
Yes, that’s it! It was rare for Yan Xiaomiao to listen to Qi Wushuang's words, so he kept up his efforts. "You can rest assured that along the way-"
"No hurry, no hurry." Yan Xiaomiao interrupted him with a smile and poured a bucket of cold water on him. "It will be better if I go back with Wuyong after he wakes up."
"..."
"Brother, is there anything else going on? If nothing happens, then I will go back to accompany Wuyong."
Qi Wushuang was speechless, and Yan Xiaomiao didn't waste any time. She turned around and was about to leave. Looking at her briskly leaving figure, Qi Wushuang finally couldn't help but sink her face and made her face the truth.
"Yan Xiaomiao, why do you continue to act crazy and deceive yourself and others like this?"
Yan Xiaomiao paused momentarily, but still did not look back. "Brother, I don't understand what you mean."
"How could you not understand?" Qi Wushuang sighed softly. "Fourth brother has been in a coma for nearly a month, and the chance of waking up is getting slimmer and slimmer. Everyone knows this, and I don't believe you don't know."
Although they also felt very heartbroken and helpless, they could only slowly accept such a thing. It was very likely that their fourth brother would not wake up again, and they had to be mentally prepared.
But she is not. She has been evading and refusing to accept the facts. This is not a good thing for her. She will have to face the facts sooner or later.
"Wuyong is just very tired... very tired, that's why he slept for so long. If you give him a little more time, I believe he will wake up..."
"Do you believe that he will definitely wake up? You are just forcing and convincing yourself, because you cannot accept the fact that he may never wake up. You are escaping!"
"I didn't..."
"You have, and you have done so from the beginning, youIf you continue like this, you will really drive yourself crazy one day, do you understand? "
"I don't understand!" Yan Xiaomiao finally turned around angrily, unable to laugh anymore. "Why, why do you each want to force me to admit that he will not wake up? You are really cruel, cruel, and extremely cold-blooded!"
Why can't she keep the last glimmer of hope? Why must she be forced into complete despair? She didn't want to do this, even if everyone gave up on him, she would never!
Unexpectedly, Yan Xiaomiao was so stubborn, which gave Qi Wushuang a very headache. "Fourth younger brother and sister, you still have a long life to live, we can't bear to see you like this..."
"Only I can decide how I want to live my life. You have no right to interfere!" She roared, no longer wanting to hear what Qi Wushuang had to say. "Even if Wuyong really never wakes up, I will not leave him. None of you can try to separate me from him!"
As soon as she finished speaking, Yan Xiaomiao immediately left decisively with an extremely stubborn attitude, which made Qi Wushuang furrowed his brows and there was absolutely nothing he could do to her.
"Fourth brother, fourth brother, if you don't wake up, you will really commit evil..."
Chapter 9(1)
Yan Xiaomiao ran back to the room angrily. Her anger was still lingering and she was panting desperately. Her lower lip she was biting was almost bleeding, but she didn't feel any pain. She only felt very...unwilling.
Why does everyone have to force her to face reality? She knows what she's doing and doesn't need them to interfere!
After finally swallowing the breath in her throat and calming down a little, Yan Xiaomiao came to the bedside and sat as before, staring at Qi Wuyong wordlessly.
He was still sleeping, sleeping so deeply, like a doll that had long lost its soul. In the past month, he never said a word or opened his eyes to look at her, leaving her alone to sing one-man shows, one after another...
She took out a pair of shell earrings from her arms. The colorful little shells were set in silver threads, swinging up and down in random directions, giving them a light and cute feeling. She caressed the texture of the shells, and she was a little lost in thought. Slowly, a faint smile appeared.
"I told you, I will let you see it, and I will never forget it..."
Thinking of the little trick Qi Wuyong used to give her earrings by surprise that day, Yan Xiaomiao couldn't help but chuckle. The emotion at that time still existed, but such precious memories... she was the only one left to remember them.
"Wuyong, I finally know that the shell looks like this. Rather than looking like ears, I think it looks like a fan. Are you playing tricks on me on purpose?"
Qi Wuyong wasn't sure, but he didn't deny it either, letting her continue to guess. "Forget it, even if you are really playing tricks on me, I admit it. The shell is very beautiful. This is my most cherished treasure at the moment. Ah... By the way, the first treasured treasure is of course you!"
Opening his palm, she placed the earring on his hand. "Do you still remember, I once said that I want you to help me put it on with your own hands, so I still refuse to wear it, because without you, this earring... will lose its precious meaning."
The preciousness of it is not how much it is worth, but the thought that Qi Wuyong put into the earring. What she cherishes is not the earring itself, but him, his sincere heart!
Picking up his hand and the shell earring in his palm, Yan Xiaomiao moved her hand to her earlobe with a look of anticipation on her face.
"Help me put on my earrings. I won't let you keep your word. Come on...it won't be difficult. Just use your fingers to hook it..."
Before his hand even touched her earlobe, the shell earring in his palm fell to the bed, causing her to freeze in all her movements.
After being stunned for a while, the sad tears finally touched the brocade quilt and the hand that was firmly held by her., began to get out of hand.
"Why...why you just refuse to wake up..."
Yan Xiaomiao completely collapsed and burst into tears. The unbearable heartache was tormenting her, driving her almost crazy.
"Qi Wuyong, answer me, answer me quickly..." Her patience has reached its limit. This month has been like torture. It has hit her deeply and made her frustrated. Her original hope has slowly passed away bit by bit, and she has begun to feel discouraged, making her feel terrified.
